# HTTP API

<!-- Generated by `uv run poe gen` from the FastAPI app. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every operation the server offers, grouped by path. Each is described by the first paragraph of its
route's docstring; one without a docstring shows the summary FastAPI derives from the function's name.
Request and response shapes are in [openapi.json](openapi.json); a running server serves them at `/docs`.
Errors: [errors.md](errors.md).

## `/api/auth`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/auth/session` | The current user, or who would be required to sign in. |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/session` | Open a session for a known address and its access code. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/auth/session` | End the current session. |

## `/api/admin`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/admin/overview` | Everyone, every team, and who is asking, for the Access panel. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/users` | Add someone to a team, or change the team and role of someone already here. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/admin/users/{email}` | Change someone's team or role, or stop them signing in. The last administrator cannot be demoted or disabled. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/users/{email}` | Remove someone and end their sessions; what they did stays in the history. Not the last administrator. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/users/{email}/password` | Give an admin their own password, or clear it back to the team code. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/teams` | Create a team. A team that already exists is left as it is. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/teams/{team_id}` | Remove a team with nobody on it. One that still has members is refused. |
| `POST` | `/api/admin/teams/{team_id}/access-code` | Issue a new access code. The plaintext is returned exactly once. |

## `/api/products`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/products` | The team's products, and whether the caller may change them. |
| `POST` | `/api/products` | Add a product to the team. Its leads and administrators only. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/products/{product_id}` | Rename, recolour or redescribe a product. Its team's leads and administrators only. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/products/{product_id}` | Delete a product, with its documents and their files, and its remembered answers. Needs `confirm=confirm`. |
| `GET` | `/api/products/{product_id}/deletion` | What deleting a product would remove, counted, for the page's warning. Changes nothing. |

## `/admin`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/admin` | A deep link to the access panel, which lives inside the app itself. |

## `/api/forms`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/forms` | Read an uploaded questionnaire, for a `product` or General, and report what can be answered in it. |
| `GET` | `/api/forms` | One person's questionnaires, most recently used first, each with the day it is kept until (plan 033). |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/list` | Keep typed questions, or a PDF's or a Word file's, as a questionnaire with no file to write into (plan 033). |
| `GET` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}` | One questionnaire. Opening it is using it: its `kept_until` starts again from now (plan 033). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}` | Delete one of the caller's questionnaires, a list's or a deleted product's too, with its answers and files. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/answer` | Answer a selection. Long: a large questionnaire is minutes of work. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/revise` | Revise Questionnaire |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/answers` | Write Answer By Hand |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/blank` | Leave a question deliberately blank rather than unanswered, or undo that. |
| `GET` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/columns` | Which column each sheet's answers go into, and why detection thinks so. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/columns` | Move a sheet's answers to a different column, or stop writing one. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/questions` | Set questions aside, bring them back, or correct their wording. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/detail` | Switch a questionnaire between full and brief answers. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/product` | Refused unless it is the questionnaire's own product: a product is fixed when the file is opened. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/answers/length` | Write this one answer full or brief, whatever the rest of the file does. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/approve` | Release one answer for writing, with the reviewer's name on it. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/approve-all` | Release these held-back answers for writing, with the reviewer's name on them (plan 041). |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/fill` | Write the confirmed answers into a copy of the original, and report the rest. |
| `GET` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/file` | The filled copy. Produced by `/fill`, which must have run first. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/skills/{skill_id}` | Reword a selection of a questionnaire's answers with one of your skills. |
| `POST` | `/api/forms/{batch_id}/answers/draft` | Undo a house style on one answer: the draft goes back as it was written. |

## `/api/knowledge`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/knowledge` | What is currently indexed for the caller's team, shared or for one `product`. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/knowledge` | Remove every policy document, shared or a `product`'s (with their files). The answer memory stays. |
| `POST` | `/api/knowledge/guidelines` | Index policy and guideline documents. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/knowledge/sources/{source_name}` | Remove one indexed policy document, from the shared knowledge base or a `product`'s (with its file). |

## `/api/memory`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/memory` | What we have said before, newest first: the shared memory, or a `product`'s. |
| `POST` | `/api/memory` | Teach the memory an answer by hand. |
| `GET` | `/api/memory/conflicts` | Pairs that disagree, with both answers, for somebody to decide between. One memory's. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/memory/{entry_id}` | Correct an entry. Not a supersession: nothing changed its mind. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/memory/{entry_id}` | Forget an entry: the row, its vector, and the conflicts it raised. |
| `POST` | `/api/memory/{entry_id}/restore` | Put a superseded entry back into use, when the later answer was wrong. |
| `POST` | `/api/memory/{entry_id}/move` | Move an entry to the shared memory (`product` empty) or a product's, and compare it again there. |
| `POST` | `/api/memory/conflicts/resolve` | Say which of two disagreeing answers is our position, or that neither loses. |
| `POST` | `/api/memory/scan` | Compare everything that has arrived since the last sweep, and report it. |

## `/api/preferences`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/preferences` | Preferences, what they add up to, and every skill this person can use. |
| `PUT` | `/api/preferences` | Save Preferences |
| `POST` | `/api/preferences/compose` | What a set of choices would tell the rewrite, without saving them. |
| `POST` | `/api/preferences/try` | What an instruction does to one answer, before it is let loose on all of them. |
| `PUT` | `/api/preferences/language` | The language this person sees the pages in, English or Arabic (plan 038). Answers are not changed. |

## `/api/documents`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/documents` | The documents somebody has uploaded, for the interface to open. |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/{origin}/{category}/{name}/file` | Open or download the original PDF/DOCX document. |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/{origin}/{category}/{name}/preview` | Return a browser preview: the original PDF or safe HTML converted from DOCX. |
| `GET` | `/api/documents/{origin}/{category}/{name}/text` | Extract and return the document text, using the persistent extraction cache. |

## `/api/assessments`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/assessments/answer` | Answer a new assessment. |
| `POST` | `/api/assessments/extract` | Pull the questions out of an assessment without answering them. |
| `POST` | `/api/assessments/answer-questions` | Answer a list of questions supplied directly, with no document involved. |
| `POST` | `/api/assessments/revise` | Reword answers the caller is holding, with no questionnaire behind them. |
| `GET` | `/api/assessments/progress/{run_id}` | How far a run has got: questions found, answered, and left to answer. |
| `POST` | `/api/assessments/export/pdf` | Render an answered assessment as a PDF. |
| `POST` | `/api/assessments/export/docx` | Render an answered assessment as a Word document. |

## `/api/chat`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/chat` | The caller's own conversations, most recently used first, each with its product. |
| `POST` | `/api/chat` | One exchange with the assistant. |
| `POST` | `/api/chat/upload` | A message with a questionnaire attached. |
| `GET` | `/api/chat/{conversation_id}` | One conversation, as a transcript plus whatever answers it has produced. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/chat/{conversation_id}` | Delete one of the caller's conversations, a deleted product's too. Its questionnaire and answers stay. |
| `POST` | `/api/chat/{conversation_id}/product` | Refused unless it is the conversation's own product: a chat's product is fixed once it starts. |
